title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development environment instructions
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific instructions for setting up and running the Temporal UI development environment in cloud agent VMs. ## What's included - Toolchain requirements (Node.js, pnpm, Go versions) - References to existing lint/test/check commands in `CLAUDE.md` - Workaround for `pnpm dev` port conflict in Cloud Agent VMs (Temporal CLI `--ui-port` conflicts with Go UI server port 8081) - Step-by-step manual service startup instructions - Notes on building the Go UI server (requires pre-built SvelteKit assets) - Important environment notes (CORS, SSR disabled, Temporal CLI auto-download) ## Development Environment Demo The Temporal UI loads on `localhost:3000`, connects to the Go UI server on port 8081 and Temporal backend on port 7233. A test workflow ("hello-world-test") was successfully created and appears with Running status. ![Temporal UI loaded](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-0984c188-77cb-47ed-8161-68b5bc79b277) ![Workflow running](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-09f31753-04d7-4596-86c2-aab7b5bca623)
